Q937.reason: Morphine is an opioid that relieves pain and causes sedation. It causes constipation, not diarrhoea.

Q922.reason: Fatigue in high-intensity exercise occurs when ATP supply can't keep up with demand. Muscle ATP stores last only seconds, not minutes.

Q992.reason: Rape is a general intent crime, so voluntary intoxication is no defense. Common-law rape did not require intent to cause serious bodily harm.
